title: Concordia receipt publish envelope contract
description: Committed schema for a Concordia receipt publish envelope that consumers may accept. The envelope has {signature, publicKey, type, data}; agent identity is derived from the verified publicKey, not from a caller-supplied agentId. The publisher-envelope signature is raw Ed25519 over JSON.stringify(data), base64url-encoded. data.did is bound to publicKey. data.receipt must carry session_id, counterparty_did, outcome, and concordia (protocol version); parties[] carries the counterparty co-signature.

type.description: Envelope type for Concordia receipt publish bodies.

publicKey.description: base64url raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key; consumers require length 32 after decode.

signature.description: base64url raw 64-byte Ed25519 signature over JSON.stringify(data); consumers require length 64 after decode.

did.description: Publisher did:key; rejected if it does not match publicKey.

concordia.description: Protocol version required to normalize the Concordia receipt.

signature.description: base64url Ed25519 counterparty co-signature; present only on the counterparty_did party.
